CHAPTER 9 - Lab 9.1 and Lab 9.2

FILES:
- index.html (optional home page listing both labs)
- ch9lab1.html (Trip Inquiry)
- ch9lab2.html (Trip Request)
- ch9lab.css (shared stylesheet)
- images/send-button.png (required image submit button for Lab 9.1)

BEFORE SUBMITTING:
1. In ch9lab1.html, ch9lab2.html, and index.html, replace YOUR_EMAIL@example.com
   with your real email address. The footer name is currently 'Cross'; edit if needed.
2. Lab 9.2 uses the free FormSubmit service. Its action is currently:
   https://formsubmit.co/YOUR_EMAIL@example.com
   Replace YOUR_EMAIL@example.com with the receiving email address.
3. Submit Lab 9.2 on the published site. On the first submission, FormSubmit
   emails the address above to confirm that you control it. Open that message,
   confirm the address, then submit a second, fully completed test request.
   Check your inbox (and spam folder) for the test request and field values.
4. Lab 9.1 intentionally uses action="#" exactly as the assignment requires.
   It is a demonstration form, not a connected inbox form.

TO PUBLISH USING GITHUB PAGES:
1. Create a public GitHub repository named chapter9 (or choose an existing repo).
2. Upload all files, keeping images/send-button.png inside an 'images' folder.
3. Open Settings > Pages > Build and deployment.
4. Source: Deploy from a branch. Branch: main, folder: /(root). Save.
5. Once GitHub shows the public URL, open:
   https://YOUR_USERNAME.github.io/chapter9/ch9lab1.html
   https://YOUR_USERNAME.github.io/chapter9/ch9lab2.html
   (Replace YOUR_USERNAME with your GitHub username. If the repo has a
   different name, replace chapter9 too.)

CHECKS TO DO:
- Open Lab 9.1, press Tab to reach every control. Select the radio buttons
  by clicking their labels. Try submitting with the name blank: a browser
  validation warning should appear.
- Open Lab 9.2, fill EVERY control, including optional fields, and send the
  test request after email verification. Confirm its email contains the values.
- Validate HTML at https://validator.w3.org/nu/ and CSS at
  https://jigsaw.w3.org/css-validator/.

NOTE: These HTML/CSS files can be reviewed offline, but this package has NOT
been published to a GitHub account or submitted to a live form service.
